statements.query: MATCH (n:AzureContainerImage)<-[:CONTAIN]-(:AzureContainerRepository)<-[:CONTAIN]-(:AzureContainerRegistry)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (n:AzureContainerImage{subscription_id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND NOT (n)<-[:CONTAIN]-(:AzureContainerRepository) WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment: Images no path reaches any more: their repository/registry was deleted first, or they were written by the pre-id loader (CONTAINS, no id).
